decisions.reason: The original Statement mixes endomorphisms of arbitrary H with matrices on C^d without a coordinate identification. This is a nonfatal, routine finite-dimensional typing omission: an ordered orthonormal basis gives a unitary U:H->C^d, and A maps to UAU*. The repair makes that map and the common matrix notation explicit, retaining all dimensions, projections, entropy conclusions, rank-deficient cases and inherited AC assumptions.

Unitary spectra and equal-weight concavity give the unchanged entropy inequality, conditional on the stated draft supplier and AC. This is the author repair review, not an independent review.
